KISWAHILI — GENERAL ASSESSMENT #18
====

GRADE: Grade 9
SUBJECT: KISWAHILI
TIME ALLOWED: 45 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 30
EXAM BODY: KJSEA

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----

   C. Copy random text without understanding Sarufi 2.4.1 Vihusishi -a unganifu sababu.
   D. Use clear examples, correct form, and a short local context for Sarufi 2.4.1 Vihusishi -a unganifu sababu.
